questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They tell drivers what traffic laws apply in that area. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that the road ahead is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs inform drivers of traffic laws. This sign means right turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You may see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign indicates a crosswalk ahead. Stay alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangular sign is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign always means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to control your speed to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped yellow signs warn drivers of a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid collisions and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will soon merge into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop at a point where you can see oncoming traffic. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you to curves ahead. Reduce your speed appropriately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate work zone activity. This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. You must obey the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that the right lane is ending. Drivers in that lane must merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign indicates a school zone. Be alert and stop if children are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of low clearance. It shows the distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this case, it is 12 feet 6 inches.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mean construction is ahead. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you the road will curve right, then left. Slow down and drive safely through the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mark school zones and school crossings. Stay alert and be prepared to stop when you see these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards. This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They show traffic laws you must follow. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must stop completely. Then look in all directions for traffic before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
Drivers may proceed through the intersection with caution.
Drivers must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red traffic light. You must stop completely and wait for a signal that allows you to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangle sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other drivers.
